Riya Agarwal | Kolkata | riya.agarwal@example.com

EDUCATION
MBA (Systems and Operations), Institute of Management Studies, Kolkata, 2026 | CGPA 7.9/10
B.Com (Hons), St. Xavier's College, Kolkata, 2024 | 78%

INTERNSHIPS
Business Analyst Intern, Paisaflow Fintech Pvt Ltd, Kolkata | Apr 2025 - June 2025 (9 weeks)
- Interviewed 12 branch staff to gather requirements for a digital gold loan application and wrote a BRD.
- Drew as-is and to-be process flows in Visio for gold loan sanction, cutting 3 manual hand-offs.
- Wrote 20 user stories with acceptance criteria for the loan application screens.
- Wrote SQL queries to check daily loan application counts against the dashboard.

Operations Intern, Eastline Logistics, Howrah | Dec 2024 - Jan 2025 (6 weeks)
- Recorded the shipment booking steps and listed delays in an Excel sheet for the operations head.

PROJECTS
- MBA live project: Mapped the patient admission process at a 50-bed nursing home and suggested a token system.
- Dashboard project: Built a sales dashboard in Power BI from a sample retail dataset for the Business Analytics course.

CERTIFICATIONS
- Google Project Management (Coursera), 2025
- Coursework: Business Process Management, Systems Analysis and Design, DBMS

SKILLS
Requirement gathering, BRD/FRD, User stories, Visio, SQL, MS Excel, Power BI, Jira, Scrum (basics)

ACTIVITIES
- Presented the to-be gold loan design to the product head and two developers at the end of the internship.
- Winner, inter-college case study competition, 2025.
